infoLinks.urlText: Bondi Junction Station Escalator 6 between the concourse and the Bus Interchange is not available
infoLinks.content:
At Bondi Junction Station Escalator 6 between the concourse and the Bus Interchange is temporarily out of service.
From Monday 18 May to Tuesday 2 June 2026, maintenance works will be taking place on the escalator that connects the concourse to the Grosvenor Street bus interchange.

Please use the Newland Street stairs or the lift as an alternative during this period.

If you need help, ask staff or phone 02 9379 4843.
